title: Dutch shipping and trade with Surinam, 1683-1795
descriptions: This dataset contains data on voyages by Dutch ships to Surinam in the period 1683-1795. It contains data on trade in general for this period.

data_sources: National Archives The Netherlands. Gemeente Archief Amsterdam. Rijksarchief van Zeeland (Middelburg). Archives of the "Sociëteit van Suriname". A codebook with further explanation is attached as PDF in this dataset.
